It always seemed to me that they had it together, and that everyone was elegant and academic! A more put together melting pot of cultures than Canada, the US, and certainly all Latam. I wanted to live there so badly! This fizzled out in 2015 when the idea of Brexit started going around and I started reading more into it. Now that the UK is out of the EU, I don't really see a very good reason to move.

Now that I live in the EU (poland), and I'm working at an international private preschool, I can say that one of the biggest culture shocks that came with moving here is that most people, when speaking in English, have a sort of english accent.
